Desktop-first control plane for HILEVEL zones against Sonos S1 and Volumio.
HILEVEL still unlocked; this plan is preliminary.

**Approach (RATIFIED for this subtodo 2026-09-07):**
- Flask harness **first** (minimal throwaway UI), then thicken the library underneath.
- Start with the **most well-documented / simplest** stack: **Volumio REST** (one assumed endpoint on the LAN, e.g. miniDSP-SHD.local).
- Then **Sonos S1**, hardcoded to zone/room **Office** (no full discovery UX required for MVP of this track).
- Drive each through **basic play/pause (or toggle) + volume** before adding the other.
- **Playlist management is OUT OF SCOPE.**

Ratchet: green tests (fixtures + optional live LAN) before the next layer. ESP32 port stays on parent todo:4a26154c after merge.
